title: Robust mean estimation under star-shaped constraints with heavy-tailed noise
summary: We study the problem of robust mean estimation with adversarially contaminated data under star-shaped constraints in a heavy-tailed noise setting, where only a finite second moment $ σ^2 $ is assumed.
